comment: Typed retention policy (#871 slice 2). Inspectable table — not hardcoded numbers. ttl_days 0 = never age-expire. age_expiry_forbidden kinds are NEVER dropped by TTL regardless of their durability field (a mislabeled volatile constraint must not silently vanish); such conflicts are kept and counted in the index summary diagnostics. Unknown kinds are kept conservatively and counted. Periods are operational estimates — tune from fleet measurement, do not copy external reference numbers.
